title: Beware of random label in mug!!!
text: Beware of random label in mug!!!. Works fine, I did think it was plain silver. It has some random lame logo...?? They do a good job of keep that piece of labeling info. Tucked away in the description. (I say if it's true...just say!) It's good for the job if your just trying to get hot drink from A to B. If wanting something fun..pick something  fun on the outside, even if it costs a few more $.

product_metadata.title: Travel Coffee Mug Stainless Steel 16 oz - Mystery Mug
features: Stainless steel coffee mug for the car
Mystery Mug - random company label/logo appears on each mug
Lowest Price - deep discounts due to random company labeling
description: If you are looking for functionality at the lowest price, then this is the stainless steel mug for you. These are high quality mugs sold at a discount because they were originally custom-labeled for companies. The company logo and wording may differ from the photograph here, but the mug itself is the same.
